reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Removed `istio.io/gateway-name`, please use `gateway.networking.k8s.io/gateway-name` label instead", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Resources using the istio.io/gateway-name label will no longer be honored; the label is removed and must be replaced with gateway.networking.k8s.io/gateway-name.

proposed.statement: The istio.io/gateway-name label has been removed; use gateway.networking.k8s.io/gateway-name instead.
